title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, enablement controls, automation calls and consumption licensing are supported. One minor clarification should acknowledge that Microsoft's feature page and responsible AI FAQ give different names for the journey review action.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent is an AI assistant in Customer Insights - Journeys that builds journey structures from natural language.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent is an AI-powered assistant in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys that lets you build customer journey structures through natural language conversation.

claims.claim: The proposed structure includes steps, timing and branching logic.
claims.quote: Describe your journey in conversational language and the agent proposes a journey structure with steps, timing, and branching logic.

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent replaces the previously released Journey Copilot for journey creation.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent replaces the previously released Journey Copilot for journey creation.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn documents the feature as a preview with documentation subject to change.
claims.quote:
[This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]
This is a preview feature.

claims.claim: The agent assembles journeys using existing segments and content assets in the environment.
claims.quote: The agent works with segments and content assets that already exist in your Customer Insights - Journeys environment.

claims.claim: The agent does not create segments in this release.
claims.quote: It assembles those assets into a logical journey flow; it doesn't create segments or write content for you in this release.

claims.claim: The agent does not write content in this release.
claims.quote: It assembles those assets into a logical journey flow; it doesn't create segments or write content for you in this release.

claims.claim: The agent presents a visual preview before publication.
claims.quote: Before you publish, the agent presents a visual preview of the proposed journey.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Review and refine opens the proposal in the standard journey designer.
claims.quote: When the proposed structure looks right, select **Review and refine** in the agent panel. The journey opens on the standard journey canvas with all proposed steps, conditions, and content assignments populated.
claims.fix: After the existing Review and refine sentence, add: "The feature page calls this action Review and refine; the responsible AI FAQ calls its review option Review and publish." The differing wording is at https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/faqs-journey-creation-agent, under Human review is required before publishing: "Use the \"Review and publish\" option".

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Nothing goes live until a person reviews and approves the journey and publishes it as usual.
claims.quote:
Nothing goes live until you approve it.
When the journey structure is correct, you can publish the journey as you usually would.

claims.claim: The preview is available only in English.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent is currently available only in English.

claims.claim: Learn says North America and Oceania customers receive the agent with the June 2026 update.
claims.quote: If you're a customer in the North America (NAM) or Oceania (OCE) region, Journey Creation Agent will be available to you with the June 2026 update.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent uses Anthropic models.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent uses Anthropic's models.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Anthropic must be allowed through both the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform admin centres for this agent.
claims.quote: Ensure your tenant is opted in through the Microsoft 365 admin center and Power Platform Admin Center to allow Anthropic to be used.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Anthropic models in Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform are excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: AI agent data might be processed and stored outside the user's primary region.
claims.quote: This means agent data might be processed and stored in regions outside the user's primary region, depending on service and infrastructure availability.

claims.claim: Prompts containing personally identifiable information or sensitive data may be blocked.
claims.quote: Prompts that contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data may be blocked.

claims.claim: Users can use only segments and content assets their account has permission to access.
claims.quote: You can only use segments and content assets that your user account has permission to access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Creating and publishing journeys requires Marketing Manager, Marketing Professional or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: A Marketing Manager or Marketing Professional role, or equivalent permissions are required to create and publish journeys.

claims.claim: AI Hub is available to the Admin role by default.
claims.quote: AI Hub is available to users with the **Admin** role by default.

claims.claim: Custom roles need agent settings permissions for msdynmkt_agentsettings.
claims.quote: If you use custom roles and permissions, add agent settings permissions for the *msdynmkt_agentsettings* entity.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin centre can restrict AI provider access to users or Microsoft Entra ID security groups.
claims.quote: You can restrict user access to AI provider subprocessors by assigning permissions to specific users or Microsoft Entra ID security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The Anthropic page says only assigned users can use agents relying on a provider when provider access is restricted.
claims.quote: When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.claim: The agent may match a similarly named segment or trigger.
claims.quote: The agent may have matched a similarly named asset in your environment. Review the entry settings and replace the segment or trigger with the correct one.

claims.claim: The agent may omit steps for channels that have not been configured.
claims.quote: If you referenced a channel not yet configured (for example, push notifications when no push app is set up), the agent may omit those steps.

claims.claim: Journeys can start from Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Service events.
claims.quote: You can describe journeys that start from events in Dynamics 365 Sales—such as when an opportunity is created or stalls—or from Dynamics 365 Customer Service events, such as when a case is resolved.

claims.claim: Sales and Customer Service integrations require those applications in the deployment.
claims.quote: Integration with Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service requires that those applications are part of your Dynamics 365 deployment

claims.claim: Sales and Customer Service integrations require an administrator to configure the relevant connections.
claims.quote: the relevant connections are configured by your administrator.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the preview is not meant for production use.
claims.quote: Preview features aren’t meant for production use and might have restricted functionality.

claims.claim: Refreshing the creation experience discards the current proposal.
claims.quote: Refreshing the page while on the creation experience discards the current proposal.

claims.claim: A proposal already transferred through Review and refine is preserved on refresh.
claims.quote: If the proposal was already transferred to the journey builder by selecting **Review and refine**, your work is preserved.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The environment or environment-group agent switch is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys > AI agents > Use AI agents.
claims.quote:
Go to **Power Platform Admin Center** > **Copilot** > **Settings**.
Scroll to the **Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys** section.
Select **AI agents**.
Set **Use AI agents** to **On** for the selected environment or environment group.

claims.claim: A tenant administrator enables the Power Platform agent setting.
claims.quote: a tenant administrator must first enable AI agents at the tenant level in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: Disabling AI agents in Power Platform admin center immediately disables active agents.
claims.quote:
If a tenant administrator disables AI agents in the **Power Platform Admin Center**:
- All active agents are **immediately disabled**.

claims.claim: Disabling AI agents at tenant level prevents new agents being created or configured.
claims.quote: New agents can't be created or configured.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for the Customer Insights - Journeys Use AI agents switch.
claims.quote: Searched: "Customer Insights" "Use AI agents" "API"; "Use AI agents" "Customer Insights" "PowerShell" "Power Platform API" "pac". Opened ai-hub and power-platform/admin/list-tenantsettings; no operation for this switch.

claims.claim: The individual enablement path is Customer Insights - Journeys > Settings > AI Hub > Add and manage agents > Add an agent > Journey Creation Agent > Overview tab > Enable.
claims.quote:
go to **Settings** and select **AI Hub** in the left navigation.
In **AI Hub**, select **Add and manage agents**.
Select **Add an agent** and choose **Journey Creation Agent**.
In the **Overview tab**, review how the agent works.
To activate the agent, select **Enable**.

claims.claim: An individual agent can be disabled in AI Hub's Add and manage agents area by selecting it and setting its status to Disabled.
claims.quote:
In AI Hub, go to **Add and manage agents**.
Select the agent.
Set the agent status to **Disabled**.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for enabling Journey Creation Agent in AI Hub.
claims.quote: Searched: "msdynmkt_agentsettings" "Web API" enable Journey Creation Agent; "msdynmkt_agentsettings" Dataverse reference. Opened ai-hub and journey-creation-agent; results describe msdyn_agentsetting, not this marketing entity or its enablement operation.

claims.claim: Credit allocation is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select **Licensing**.
Under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**, and then select **Manage Copilot Credits**.
Select the environment that you want to manage.

claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 accepts scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements with MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and enforcementRules containing TenantPool enabled false.
claims.quote:
All programmatic examples in this article use API version `2024-10-01`.
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put
-Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
@{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }

claims.claim: Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator can manage credit allocations.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the **Power Platform Administrator** or **Global Administrator** role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Tenant Anthropic opt-in is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic.
claims.quote:
select **Copilot** > **Settings** > **View all**.
Select **AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors**.
On the **AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors** page, under **Available subprocessors for your organization**, select **Anthropic**, and **Save**.

claims.claim: AI Administrator or Global Administrator can configure tenant Anthropic access.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the [AI Administrator] or [Global Administrator] role to perform this task.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for the tenant Anthropic provider setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic provider enable disable Microsoft 365 Copilot Microsoft Graph API Power Platform environment PowerShell settings; "Anthropic" "API" "settings" "Graph" provider admin. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor; no corresponding Graph operation.

claims.claim: Environment provider settings are at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote:
select **Manage**.
In the **Manage** pane, select **Environments**, and then select the environment.
On the command bar, select **Settings**.
On the **Settings** page, select **Product** > **Features**.

claims.claim: Enabling the provider in Microsoft 365 is required first and does not automatically allow it in Power Platform.
claims.quote: First, a Microsoft 365 AI administrator enables access to a model provider. Then, a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group. Enabling a provider in Microsoft 365 doesn't automatically make its models available in Power Platform.

claims.claim: Environment groups use the Power Platform Anthropic rule to govern Anthropic models.
claims.quote: **Power Platform Anthropic** | Controls Power Platform Anthropic models.

claims.claim: A Power Platform system admin allows provider models in an environment or environment group.
claims.quote: a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for the Power Platform Anthropic environment setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Anthropic" "PowerShell" "environment" models; "Anthropic" "Power Platform" "API" "TenantSettings". Opened allow-llm-generative-responses, list-tenantsettings and organization Web API reference; no corresponding provider setting operation.

claims.claim: Cross-region consent is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Generative AI features > Edit > Move data across regions.
claims.quote:
select **Manage**.
Select **Environments**.
On the **Environments** page, select the target environment.
In the environment details page, locate the **Generative AI features** card and select **Edit**.
Review the terms of use.
Select the **Move data across regions** checkbox.
